series_3.residual_risk_guest_axiom: two, named and unpriced (design section 7a): (1) authorship provenance -- G-P0 recasts 30 maintainer-authored questions, so the hypotheses are the maintainer's not a stranger's (the HANDLES contamination); the 20 real corrections narrow it, a stranger's guest hypotheses stay unmeasured. (2) ontology-shared closed world -- GUEST AXIOM inherits ECHO's ~8,500-term-universe risk: it measures whether a supplied EXPRESSIBLE hypothesis yields a checked implication, never whether a person's actual assumption is expressible at all
